title: Integration consumer reads resource context before its initialization cell
symptom: The production-entry-integration cell Failed with AttributeError after its actual Unity command exited0 and emitted all five P01–P05 reports, valid live policy-domain evidence and integration.json with zero changed roots/closure.
reproduction: Use the exact four executed source commits and single prescribed batch-P argv in /Users/ah/GitHub/hybridclr/r03-local-validation/Preflight-R03LocalBatch-20261006P-lo-repair/runner-exit.json. Do not retry this root.

The exact Unity integration argv is retained in /Users/ah/GitHub/hybridclr/r03-local-validation/R03LocalBatch-20261006P-lo-repair/commands/0126/command.json. Unity succeeds, emits compiler-policy-domains.json and integration.json, and passes all three linked-policy guards plus restored-baseline zero-root/zero-closure proof.

CompletionBatch.execute invokes resource_pipeline.integration before resource-input-binding. The Python consumer then evaluates batch.resource_context at resource_pipeline.py:165; that attribute is initialized only by graph(), which the next cell invokes. The original cell therefore records the exact AttributeError while later resource-input-binding passes.

rootCause: The new live-policy consumer binds its baseline hash through batch.resource_context, but the only assignment to that attribute occurs in resource_pipeline.graph. The execution plan schedules production-entry-integration before that graph cell. Earlier resource phases and CompletionBatch initialization never create the attribute.
whyDesignAllowedIt: The consumer gained a new implicit data dependency without updating the orchestrator lifecycle or declaring an authenticated prerequisite. Host/compiler checks cover the policy verifier and Unity helper but not the complete Python cell-order/dataflow contract.
affectedScope: One integration ledger verdict and therefore the batch result. Valid fresh Unity subproofs, six builds, both Editor rosters, graph bindings and independent Player results retain separate factual states.
recommendedDirection: Make resource context availability an explicit authenticated prerequisite for the integration consumer, or bind the report directly to the already-authenticated current ON build/snapshot receipt. Preserve all source/linked policy, current-project/source pin and baseline-hash checks; do not bypass the missing dependency or relabel P.
remainingUncertainty: Primary owns the precise dataflow choice. The Unity implementation completed successfully in P; a repaired Python orchestration path has not been executed against a fresh source-bound batch.
validationAfterRepair: Add a full orchestration-order regression that follows actual CompletionBatch initialization/cell execution without pre-populating resource_context. Revalidate the original integration consumer, five eligibility reports, policy byte stability/all three guards and restored-baseline zero roots/closure in a new unused source-bound complete batch; preserve P unchanged.
